Volunteer George Henry Andersen (1907–1968)
Born: Cambridge, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Resting Place: Fort Snelling National Cemetery, Minneapolis.

Soldado Owen Appleton (1909–1937)
Born: Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Killed in Action at Fuentes de Ebro.

Volunteer Edward Barrett (1915–1938)
Born: Boston, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1938.
Killed in Action at Corbera.

Section Leader Julian James Baublis (1901–1937)
Born: Worcester, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Killed in Action at Fuentes de Ebro.

Soldado Norman Nathan Berkowitz (1913–2010)
Born: Boston, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Resting Place: Arden, Buncombe, North Carolina.

Pilot George Berry (1896–1943)
Born: Whitinsville, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1936.
Resting Place: Pine Grove Cemetery, Northbridge, Massachusetts.

Battalion Adjutant Paul Arthur Burns (1906–1996)
Born: Somerville, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Resting Place: New York City.

Soldado George Aloysius Raymond Carroll (1897–1952)
Born: Lowell, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1938.
Resting Place: Beverly National Cemetery, New Jersey.

Volunteer Barton Carter (1915–1938)
Born: Newton, Massachusetts. Acquired overseas passport in 1935, volunteer date unknown.
Killed in Action at Aragon.

Volunteer William Chestna (1906–1937)
Born: Bridgewater, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Killed in Action at Brunete.

Volunteer Abraham Cohen (1914–1937)
Born: Boston, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Killed in Action at Jarama.

Soldado Charles William Cronin (1904–?)
Born: Newton, Massachusetts. Volunteered 1937.
Returned to US in 1938. Resting place unknown.
